    # Try all permutations of the numbers
    for perm in itertools.permutations(nums):
        a, b, c, d = perm
        # Try all choices of three operators
        for opers in itertools.product(ops, repeat=3):
            op0, op1, op2 = opers
            # Five ways to parenthesize four numbers
            templates = [
                f"(({a}{op0}{b}){op1}{c}){op2}{d}",
                f"({a}{op0}({b}{op1}{c})){op2}{d}",
                f"{a}{op0}(({b}{op1}{c}){op2}{d})",
                f"{a}{op0}({b}{op1}({c}{op2}{d}))",
                f"({a}{op0}{b}){op1}({c}{op2}{d})",
            ]
            for t in templates:
                try:
                    if abs(eval(t) - target) < 1e-6:
                        return t
                except ZeroDivisionError:
                    continue
    return None

def solve(nums, target):
    # items: list of (value, expr_str)
    items = [(float(n), str(int(n))) for n in nums]
    def helper(items):
        if len(items) == 1:
            v, e = items[0]
            if abs(v - target) < 1e-6:
                return e
            return None
        # try all ordered pairs
        for i in range(len(items)):
            for j in range(len(items)):
                if i == j:
                    continue
                a_v, a_e = items[i]
                b_v, b_e = items[j]
                rest = [items[k] for k in range(len(items)) if k != i and k != j]
                for op in ops:
                    # avoid duplicate commutative cases
                    if (op == '+' or op == '*') and i > j:
                        continue
                    # no division by zero
                    if op == '/' and abs(b_v) < 1e-6:
                        continue
                    # compute
                    if op == '+': v = a_v + b_v
                    elif op == '-': v = a_v - b_v
                    elif op == '*': v = a_v * b_v
                    else: v = a_v / b_v
                    e = f"({a_e}{op}{b_e})"
                    sol = helper(rest + [(v, e)])
                    if sol:
                        return sol
        return None
    return helper(items)

def find_expr(nums, exprs):
    if len(nums) == 1:
        if abs(nums[0] - target) < 1e-6:
            return exprs[0]
        return None
    n = len(nums)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            a, b = nums[i], nums[j]
            ea, eb = exprs[i], exprs[j]
            rest_nums = [nums[k] for k in range(n) if k not in (i, j)]
            rest_exprs = [exprs[k] for k in range(n) if k not in (i, j)]
            # generate all results of a and b
            candidates = []
            candidates.append((a + b, f"({ea}+{eb})"))
            candidates.append((a - b, f"({ea}-{eb})"))
            candidates.append((b - a, f"({eb}-{ea})"))
            candidates.append((a * b, f"({ea}*{eb})"))
            if abs(b) > 1e-12:
                candidates.append((a / b, f"({ea}/{eb})"))
            if abs(a) > 1e-12:
                candidates.append((b / a, f"({eb}/{ea})"))

    return None
